thread:
jamal: quick postmortem follow-up from the EU failover dry-run earlier today — threading up action items we promised to own. TL;DR: routing flap still reproducible under spike, snapshot restores slower than expected, runbook step order ambiguous for partial-region restores.

maria: thanks for the summary. I pushed the checklist notes into TSK-7893. main ask: can we get owners and ETA for each remediation?

chris: taking multi-region routing config audit. I'll validate route-weights + health-check windows. assigning myself to TSK-7893.eta: EOW (fri). :white_check_mark:

jamal: awesome. chris, plz capture any mismatches between our intent and cloud router policies (esp. fallback priority) and add concrete roll-forward steps.

chris: noted. quick check command I'll run:
```
# list weighted routes and health-probes
gcloud compute url-maps describe redwood-ingress --region=europe-west1
kubectl get svc -n infra router-probe -o yaml
```

sara: I'll own the snapshot/restore perf work — looks like snapshot copies were queued behind backup retention jobs during the rehearsal. I'll run a focused restore with dedicated throughput schedule. adding ticket TSK-7901. ETA: Mon afternoon. :calendar:

maria: i'll own runbook clarity — specifically step 4.2 vs 4.3 where we leave tokens unflushed. Will write explicit pre-restore checklist and a short decision tree for partial vs full restores. linking to TSK-7893 and TSK-7901. ETA: Tue morning.

ops-bot: deploybot: Deployment 2026-03-19T14:02 UTC to infra/backup-scheduler started by @sara — logs: https://ci.redwood/dep/4421 :truck: 

jamal: linking a few follow-ups so we can track in the weekly DR cadence:
- TSK-7893 (routing audit) -> owner: chris -> due: Fri EOW
- TSK-7901 (restore perf) -> owner: sara -> due: Mon 18:00 UTC
- TSK-7894 (runbook edit + decision tree) -> owner: maria -> due: Tue 10:00 UTC
- INC-4321 (recurring routing spike pattern) -> owners: eng-runtime + eng-sre -> wip; need hypothesis sync

chris: for INC-4321 i'll add a short telemetry query and a dashboard tile; want to see cross-region p95 latency vs route-weight shifts. putting it on my plate but will need help from eng-runtime to instrument KV-cache metrics.

maria: can we schedule a 30m game-day to validate the fixes next week? propose Wed 15:00 UTC. game-day should include: controlled traffic spike, restore from snapshot, and route failover simulation. :eyes:

jamal: Wed 15:00 UTC works for me. sara/chris/maria please add calendar invites and include runbook pre-reqs. i'll be the incident lead for the practice run. ops-bot please mark this as a DR-playbook rehearsal.

ops-bot: calendarbot: Event created: "DR rehearsal — routing & restore practice" Wed 2026-03-25 15:00 UTC. Invitees: jamal, maria, chris, sara, eng-runtime, eng-sre. Reminder 30m prior.

sara: one more note — during the dry-run we saw ~12% of restore attempts fail on checksum mismatch due to partial shard replays. i'll capture sample logs in TSK-7901 and add mitigation steps (retry policy + shard-verify).

jamal: perfect. i'll own coordination and follow-ups in the DR cadence doc. please update the tickets above with status and short test plan before EOD tomorrow so I can synthesize for leadership. cheers all. :thumbsup:
